description.value: Year-round RV park in pine forest on the bench lands above Peachland, a short ride from Okanagan Lake beaches and area wineries; cyclists can tent at full RV-site rates with an optional private washroom (shower, toilet, sink) delivered to your site for $39/night extra.

address.value: 4795 Paradise Valley Drive, Peachland, BC V0H 1X3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides comprehensive amenity details for Peachland RV Park. Key confirmations from website text: all sites include water and 50/30 amp power, showers and laundry are available year-round, an onsite store and concession serve food, and online booking is explicitly offered. OSM held only name and tourism=caravan_site tags with no address or phone; both were sourced from the website's contact and location pages and are internally consistent across multiple subpages.
concerns: OSM record is very sparse — only name and tourism=caravan_site tags; no address, phone, or email present in OSM. Address and phone sourced entirely from website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
OSM community field shows 'Kelowna' but the park is physically located in Peachland — likely a regional grouping artifact rather than a data error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate year-round campground with tent camping, water, power, showers, and laundry; touring cyclists can stay here and benefit from onsite services and proximity to Okanagan cycling routes.

wow_evidence: cyclists can tent at full RV-site rates; showers and laundry are available year-round
